calcium intake is important to the skeleton and that dairy foods are a good source of calcium.
the balance of data suggests calcium intake has a beneficial effect on the prevention and treatment osteoporosis.
dairy products are an efficient and convenient source of absorbable calcium and are an important component of a diet designed to prevent osteoporosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the calcium intake of the population should be increased.
calcium is an important nutrient for bone health and that milk is the most convenient and economical source of absorbable calcium.
the bioavailability of calcium is highly variable and depends upon the food matrix, calcium status, and age.
The main takeaway from our work is that
milk and dairy foods are good sources of calcium, and they are the most efficient sources in the human diet.
the best way to obtain calcium is through the diet and the best source of calcium is from dairy products.
the calcium bioavailability of dairy products is similar to that of most other food sources, and the calcium bioavailability from most vegetable sources is at least equal to that from dairy foods.
